releases.body:
OpenCode Desktop quota dashboard v0.1.0

Install:
`opencode plugin add opencode-quota-dashboard`

Highlights:
- Floating capsule for the current provider quota
- DeepSeek balance, OpenCode Go pool, GLM and MiMo usage
- `/quota`, `/quota-settings`, side panel and settings page

Requires OpenCode Desktop 2.2.7; connect your own DeepSeek / OpenCode Go / Z.AI / Xiaomi credentials.
